title: Marvelous Designer 2024.2: Trim Simulation With Collision
description:

***Make sure to use CPU simulation for this feature***
 There are a few bugs for 2024.2 which we are working on resolving:
- Collision handling between Trim and other Trims, Scene & Props, and Avatars

summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 2024.2: Trim Simulation With Collision Welcome to the 2024.2 new feature videos. In this video, we will look at Trim Simulation with Collision. ## New Features in Trim Simulation First, a simulation option has been added to the Trim right-click menu. Three menu options have been added: **Freeze**, **Activate**, and **Deactivate**. The biggest update to this feature is that when Trim is activated, it will be simulated along with the pattern and will be affected by gravity. ## Moving the Trim You can move the Trim by pinching it during the simulation. > **Note:** This action can be repeated multiple times for adjustments. ## Handling Mesh Collision For Trim elements such as buckles and rings that have small holes, the mesh can often clip through them. To prevent this, lower the pattern's additional collision thickness to facilitate stable simulation. ## Adjusting Trim Weight While simulation is active, you can adjust the trim weight in the Trim Style property window under **Weight Value**. ### Freezing and Deactivating Trim When you freeze the trim, the position of the trim will be locked where it is in the 3D window. Conversely, when you deactivate a trim, it will be excluded from any simulation calculations. If you'd like to drape the fabric to fit the trim fixed at a position, please kindly use the **Freeze** function. ## Collision Properties The entire mesh body of the trim now has collision applied. Before version 2024.2, the glued trim only had limited collision properties. ## Adjusting Trim Stiffness You can also adjust the stiffness of trims. When a trim is activated, the stiffness value is active in the object properties of each individual trim. To represent a trim that is made of a soft material, lowering the stiffness value will cause the trim to bend according to the simulation. > **Important Note:** Upon release, trims do not collide with other trims, scenes and props, or avatars. ## Limitations of Trim Simulation The Trim Simulation function does not work in the GPU simulation state. Additionally, Trim Simulation does not work when recording animations. ## Undo and Redo Functionality The Undo and Redo function is supported. ## Initiating Trim Simulation To initiate Trim Simulation, hit the designated key. Then press the appropriate button to resume. ```
